newsitem.title: USA: Conseco to be added to S&P 500 Index.
newsitem.headline: Conseco to be added to S&P 500 Index.

text.p: The Equity Services Group of Standard & Poor's Corp. said it will replace Alexander & Alexander Services Inc. in the S&P 500 index with Conseco Inc. after the close of trading Tuesday.
Aon Corp., a component of the S&P index of 500 stocks, is acquiring Alexander & Alexander through a friendly $1.23 billion cash tender offer scheduled to expire Tuesday.

Conseco, a holding company based in Carmel, Ind., that operates annuity, life, and health insurance companies. It also offers asset management and related services, will be added to the S&P 500 Insurance (Life/Health) industry group in the Financial economic sector.

The Equity Services Group of Standard & Poor's, a division of the Financial Information Services Group of The McGraw-Hill Cos, provides financial, economic, and investment information, as well as analytical services, to the global financial community and commodity trading markets.

The S&P Equity Services Group calculates and maintains the S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, S&P SmallCap 600, and the S&P Super Composite 1500 stock price indexes, which are widely considered key barometers of stock market activity and performance benchmarks for professional money managers.
More than $400 billion is currently indexed to the S&P 500.
